digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and G7 grading
propositions: G7 routing entry must change from default_posture advisory at 0.95 to default_posture blocking at 0.85 to enable plan-review blocking on high-validity divergence findings matching historical quality evidence (0 clearly-incorrect at threshold 0.85 over 348 findings).

G7 blocking threshold 0.85 admits both floor-grade kinds (contradicts_reality and omits_required_site, each hard-floored at impact 0.85) while incomplete_enumeration at impact 0.55 remains advisory, scoped by the existing plan-v4 divergence grading axis not new per-grade Pass-3 machinery.

G7 rubric must add four new guidance rules: abstain-with-coverage on unresolvable parents (never emit as finding), closed-parent checked against final state with sibling-handoff scope not a violation, one finding per contradicted parent clause (dedup-at-source pattern), and floor-kind guidance distinguishing genuine contract contradictions from cosmetic wording mismatches.
Unresolvable parent findings must abstain with covered-but-unverified note instead of blocking, following the T13/T14 fail-open pattern.

Same-issue duplicate findings must deduplicate at source to emit at most one finding per contradicted parent clause with additional manifestations folded into evidence, following the c97a T5c pattern.
